original_agent_description: Node-agnostic verification-failure debugger. Buckets failures by error signature, PARSES THE VCD WAVEFORM to locate X-states, stuck signals and activity around the failure time, reduces a failing stimulus to a 1-minimal reproducer by real delta debugging (ddmin) against an EXECUTED oracle, and establishes determinism by RE-RUNNING the reproducer and comparing normalized outcomes -- never by observing that a seed was supplied, since a fixed seed does not constrain uninitialised state, wall-clock entropy or iteration order. Waveform-derived hypotheses outrank log-text matches. Anything it could not execute or read is reported as not_assessable, never as clean. Emits a Common Design Envelope.
